mapper.select: SELECT c.CASE_ID, c.MEMBER_ID, c.LAWYER_ID, c.TITLE, c.CASE_TYPE, c.STATUS, c.STEP, TO_CHAR(c.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(c.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATED_AT FROM TB_CASE c LEFT JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON c.LAWYER_ID = l.LAWYER_ID WHERE c.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} OR l.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY c.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT CASE_ID, MEMBER_ID, LAWYER_ID, TITLE, CASE_TYPE, STATUS, STEP, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATED_AT FROM TB_CASE WHERE CASE_ID = #{caseId}

SELECT CASE_ID, MEMBER_ID, LAWYER_ID, TITLE, CASE_TYPE, STATUS, STEP, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATED_AT FROM TB_CASE ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CASE SET STEP = #{step}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE CASE_ID = #{caseId}
